title: Peak Widget Margin
description: An automated trading bot analyzes historical daily prices of a single widget to maximize profit. Given an array of prices where prices[i] is the price of the widget on the i-th day, find the maximum profit you can achieve by choosing a single day to buy one widget and choosing a different day in the future to sell that widget. If no profit can be achieved, return 0.
input_format: An array of integers representing daily prices.
output_format: An integer representing the maximum possible profit.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 2 (price = 1) and sell on day 5 (price = 6), profit = 6 - 1 = 5.
In this case, no transactions are done and the max profit = 0.
Buy on day 3 (price = 1) and sell on day 4 (price = 7), profit = 7 - 1 = 6.
